reason: The hypothesis directly restates the crack-mitigation strategy and mechanism already reported in P6 and P25, where preheating the substrate to ~500 °C was used to reduce thermal gradients and prevent cracking in additively manufactured HEAs. It proposes the same intervention on similar materials with the same predicted outcome, without combining findings from different papers or transferring the idea to a new context.
copied_elements: preheating build platform to reduce thermal gradients and cracking
mechanism: reduced temperature differential diminishes shrinkage, warpage, and stress concentrations
predicted outcome: reduced warpage, microcrack density, improved dimensional accuracy and mechanical properties
falsification test: standard comparative experiment with and without preheating
